title: pilosella glaucochroa
intro: Pilosella glaucochroa, commonly known as a plant species belonging to the Asteraceae family, is a type of flowering plant. It is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce inflammation and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Pilosella glaucochroa include its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit antimicrobial activity, and display hepatoprotective effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpene lactones, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
